svg.title: FIG-03 当前配置与原子生成 FIG-03 Current configuration and generation
svg.desc: 一份 authored TOML one authored TOML assembly; SoC / CPU / routes 事实 SoC / CPU / route facts; Board 接线与来源事实 Board wiring and provenance; 严格 TOML 字段检查 → 冻结用户意图 strict TOML fields -> frozen AuthoredAssembly; 严格解析：字段、模式、资源、输入身份 strict field / mode / resource / identity checks; 不可变具名 IR：每个决策只存一次 immutable named IR: each decision stored once; SoC 构造：静态定义与冷态调用 SoC Construction: static definitions and cold calls; 事务生成与原子发布 transactional generation and atomic publish; 静态实例 / factory / 配置 / 内存预算 / resolved.json static instances / factory / config / budgets / resolved.json; CMake：唯一软件目标图 CMake: sole software target graph; Ninja：编译、链接、资源检查 Ninja: compile / link / resource checks; ELF / BIN / map / 资源报告 ELF / BIN / map / resource reports; 拒绝 / 生成失败 rejected input or generation failure; owned bundle 失效，不暴露半成品 invalidate owned bundle, no partial outputs; 唯一装配入口 sole assembly input; 尚未准入的选择 unresolved selections; 芯片能力 silicon capability; Board 授权 Board authorization; 验证通过 validated; 具名字段 named fields; 生成 binding C 字节 render binding C bytes; 单向 JSON / 配置 / 内存投影 one-way JSON / config / memory projection; 成功发布 atomic publish; 配置与生成源 configuration and generated sources; 执行目标图 execute target graph; 本次实际产物 actual artifacts of this execution; 语法 / 字段非法 invalid syntax / fields; 生成失败 emission failure; 非法 / 冲突 / 变化 invalid / conflict / input changed; 生成或发布失败 generation or publish failure; 仅清理拥有的输出 invalidate owned outputs only
